notes: Pinhole fronto-parallel target geometry, not a recall guarantee. Slant, occlusion and motion reduce useful detail.
Speed formula assumes transverse image motion at the specified range; rotation consumes the same blur budget.
RGB rolling-shutter distortion, vibration and focus require separate measured tests.

scenarios.title: Branch intersects rotor envelope despite clear endpoints
Missing depth behind foliage blocks the corridor
Loss of localization requests takeover without a position proposal
Fresh map header cannot hide expired voxel evidence
Hover, gather distinct observations, approach through a known same-height corridor
Old semantic detections cannot authorize approach while live depth stays healthy
Ground mushroom never causes a descent command
Abort does not invent a return path

limitations: Synthetic free-space maps and synthetic candidate evidence, not observed woodland or detector measurements.
Ideal kinematics only; PX4 SITL, ROS 2, OAK-D and Jetson integration have not been executed.
No sockets, serial ports, arm commands or flight commands are sent.
A forward camera alone does not establish coverage behind, above, below or beside the aircraft.
Declared-free voxels in the fixture are ground truth supplied by the simulator. Real mapping must explicitly raycast freespace and preserve unknown cells.
